conditions.evidence: adult burn patients admitted to the Intensive Care Unit
conditions.label: Burns

output.population: 9 adult burn ICU patients from the intervention group of a trial of 82 patients, ages 18–65
output.summary: Electrophysiological recordings (EEG, ECG, EMG) taken during music therapy sessions with adult burn patients in intensive care, from a subset of the intervention arm of an ongoing randomized clinical trial, alongside pain and anxiety-depression measures.
